scripts.dev: npm --prefix backend exec -- concurrently "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.prisma:gen: cd backend || exit 1; npm run prisma:gen
scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); if (path.resolve(process.env.INIT_CWD || '') === process.cwd()) { if (fs.existsSync('package-lock.json')) fs.rmSync('package-lock.json', { force: true }); console.error('\nDo not install packages in the root directory! Change into /frontend or /backend first.\n'); process.exit(1); }"
